member.name: T:Milvaion.Application.Dtos.MetricReportDtos.MetricReportSummaryDto
member.summary: Metric report metadata without the report payload.
member.remarks:
carries the full jsonb Data for every row it returns, which is fine for a dashboard that renders a chart per card and expensive for anything that only needs to know which reports exist. A page of twenty throughput reports is a few hundred kilobytes of aggregated series, none of it read if the caller is deciding which report to open.
This shape answers "what is there and how fresh is it" and leaves fetching the payload to the detail query. is kept so the size of that follow-up call is known before it is made.

Populated after materialisation rather than in the projection: the age is relative to now, and pushing DateTime.UtcNow into the SQL translation is both fragile and pointless when the row is about to be read in memory anyway.

member.name: T:Milvaion.Application.Dtos.WorkflowDtos.WorkflowRunAnalysisDto
member.summary: A workflow run flattened into a form that can be read top to bottom without joining anything.
member.remarks:
exists to drive the DAG canvas, so it hands back three parallel collections - step runs, step definitions and edges - keyed by GUID, plus layout coordinates. A UI resolves those references with a lookup table. A reader without one has to hold every GUID in mind at once to answer a question as ordinary as "what stopped the pipeline", and the answer is usually wrong.
This shape resolves the references up front. Dependencies are step names rather than ids, the definition and the run outcome for a step live on the same object, layout coordinates are dropped, and the collapse of the run is stated directly in and rather than left to be inferred from the absence of a record.

○ Match a character in the set [+/-9A-Za-z] atomically at least once.
